featured_reviews.name: Nirav Gangar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited a few times here for dinners & lunches now and had an amazing experience both the times.

Below are the food items we have tried here -
1. Sweet corn soup - It was nice and sweet.
2. Burnt garlic soup - Loved the taste. Highly recommend having it if you like garlic and soups.
3. Lemon coriander soup - It was a nice soup. Can try.
4. Lotus Kurkure with schezwan sauce - You love having lotus stem roots then this is a must order for you. Right amount of crispy and tasty.
5. Waterchest nut in sambal sauce - Enjoyed this starter as well. Very well made and can order during the waterchest nut season.
6. Special stuff kulcha - It was nice and stuffed well. It became very filling just having 1 portion of the kulcha with the vegetables.
8. Veg. Makhmali - finely chopped mix vegetable sabzi in red gravy. Have visited the restaurant many times now and this is the one which I have loved the most and the taste has been the same always and never disappointed.
9. Lasuni Paneer - paneer pieces in yellow lasuni gravy.
10. Paneer veg Diwani masala - Nice mix vegetable medium chopped with paneer pieces in red gravy.
11. Orange mojito - It was very sweet so did not like it as we were expecting it to have a tangy flavour.
12. Ginger twist - It was flavourful and absolutely loved having it as I love ginger.
13. Masala chaas - It was very refreshing. Highly recommended.
14. Roti - In roties, we have tried many and would only say that you can order whichever you liked. You won’t go wrong. They have Garlic option in all the Indian breads so that is fantastic.

All in all it’s an amazing restaurant for North Indian food in Matunga area if you are a member or know someone who is.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Refreshing Oasis in the Heart of Mumbai

As a resident of Mahim, I've been frequenting the Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool for many years, and I've always been impressed by its facilities and the overall swimming experience it offers. While there's always room for improvement, I believe the pool deserves a solid 4-star rating, reflecting its strengths and acknowledging the areas where it could enhance its offerings.

Cleanliness and Maintenance:

The pool complex is generally well-maintained, with clean and hygienic pools, changing rooms, and shower areas. The staff regularly checks the water quality, ensuring it meets the necessary standards. While there have been instances of minor cleanliness issues, they've been promptly addressed by the staff.

Facilities and Amenities:

The pool complex boasts a variety of amenities catering to swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The main pool, an Olympic-sized one, is ideal for lap swimming and training. The separate diving pool is perfect for practicing dives and aquatic stunts. Additionally, there's a smaller pool for kids, providing a safe and fun environment for them to learn and enjoy the water.

Pool Staff and Safety:

The pool staff is generally helpful and attentive, ensuring the safety of swimmers at all times. Experienced lifeguards are stationed around the pools, keeping a watchful eye on everyone. The pool also has clear signage and safety guidelines in place to minimize the risk of accidents.

Overall Experience:

Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool is a great place to come for a refreshing swim, whether you're looking for a leisurely workout or a fun family outing. The pool's facilities are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the safety measures are commendable. While there's always room for improvement, the pool consistently delivers a positive swimming experience, earning it a solid 4-star rating.

Areas for Improvement:

Parking: The pool's parking facilities can be limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. Expanding the parking area or introducing valet parking services would be beneficial.

Shower Rooms: The shower rooms could be refurbished to provide a more modern and comfortable experience. Upgrading the fixtures and adding more shower cubicles would enhance the overall experience.

Food Options: While there are a few snack and beverage options available at the canteen it closes by 9 pm and expanding the food menu to include more substantial meals would cater to swimmers who spend longer hours at the pool.

Despite these areas for improvement, Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool remains a valuable asset to the Dadar community and a popular choice for both casual swimmers and fitness enthusiasts. Its dedication to cleanliness, safety, and providing a welcoming environment makes it a rewarding place to spend a day in the water.

featured_reviews.name: aditi mane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited Wadala Sports Club multiple times, either for bookings or to enquire about facilities. Unfortunately, the experience has been consistently disappointing because of the rude and unprofessional behaviour of the receptionist and some staff members who seevrely lack professionalism and customer retention.

On one occasion some 3-4 months back during heavy rains, I was left stranded at the entrance with my car because the parking gate was shut and no watchman was present. There was another car parked blocking the entrace of the parking and there was no way to park the car near the gate as it would have caused nuisance to others. we opened the gate ourselves but struggled with where to park the car. Despite clearly seeing the situation stading on the main door of the club, the receptionist refused to offer any assistance or even call someone to guide us. Instead, I had to leave my car outside and then walk in the rain to enter the club, and ended up drenched while entering the club for an event. Later, I saw the same receptionist casually sitting with the watchman he had claimed was unavailable.

On another occasion, when I visited with a friend to enquire about the club’s sports activities and fees, his attitude was dismissive. He simply told us to “read the circular” and refused to answer any questions, even when we had doubts after reading the notice. Instead of being welcoming and helpful, he was curt and arrogant — an attitude unbecoming of the first point of contact for a members’ club.

The club facilities may be good, but this kind of customer-facing behaviour reflects very poorly on the institution. Members and visitors expect courtesy, guidance, and respect, not indifference and attitude.

Unless the management takes steps to train or replace such staff, I cant whole heartedly recommend Wadala Sports Club.

featured_reviews.name: Marie Rose
featured_reviews.review_text:
This review is only for those parent(s) who are from middle class background and who know basic swimming that was learnt from their parents or from a professional and who are expecting that their child would pick basic swimming in their 60 sessions of Michael Phelps at Sahar Plaza Andheri East.

I would not recommend this place and instead if you have a pool within your society take your kid there and teach swimming as it is not rocket science but only practice. I enrolled my six year old daughter on 05/11/2025 with expiry on July 5, 2026 for 60 sessions as you can see from the swimming card. I was told that first 12 sessions was making the kid comfortable in water, gliding in water and jumping into water without fear which my daughter did. In reality, she was doing this for 15 sessions till I took them to task and asked them when they would start teaching her swimming that only then did they began her swimming classes. My kid was happy in the pool and was picking swimming quite well with confidence till 18th March on the 28th session when the head coach asked me about renewal as there was an offer going on. I told the coach that my expiry was not due and I will do it at that time irrespective of the offer. After that on the 29th session, the instructor who was teaching my kid started behaving oddly with my kid. He would instead of focussing on her swimming, started holding her when she was swimming or when she was jumping in water. Suddenly, in that one day, my daughter told me that if she didn’t swim properly, she would drown. The next session, I again noticed the same behaviour in the instructor and I realized that the instructor was hitting the confidence of my daughter by holding her hand when she jumped in the water which was never done with her. That was the last session of my daughter with Michael Phelps and on that day I gave earful to the head coach and questioned how the instructor had undermined the confidence of my kid. I told the head coach that till date the instructor never held the hand of my daughter whenever she jumped into the water and why did he hold only her hand and not the hand of any other kids who had jumped in the water. On hindsight, I realized that since I did not commit a renewal when asked to do so, the coaches decided to slow the progress of learning swimming of my kid so that I would do another 60 sessions and what is worse is for greed of money they hit the confidence of my kid in water by instilling fear of drowning so much so that it took me another 8 sessions in the pool of my society to rectify this fear. I decided to forgo the remaining 30 sessions of my daughter as I don’t want to entrust her with teachers who instilled fear instead of positive learning and it takes a long time to unlearn that instilled fear.
Coming to my background, I learnt swimming from my mother in a local pond in 10 days and so did my husband. After that, I sharpened my swimming with breathing technique in 15 days by a trainer. All my instructors be it my mother or the trainer told me only one thing – Be free in water and water will always push you upwards and the moment you struggle you will sink, so just be free in water and feel the water. This was a positive learning that I got about swimming. This learning takes time but it is positive learning and helps in swimming. The moment you talk to a child about drowning, the child learns fear not swimming.

So for those parents who think that their kid will learn swimming here in 60 sessions, its not going to happen without a renewal at Michael Phelps. The techniques taught here are all good but when a kid’s confidence is hit, it is difficult. If you have the money, then honey Michael Phelps is for you.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am sharing this review to give honest feedback about this swimming centre.

The teachers and reception staff are generally helpful and sincere. One teacher noticed that my child was losing confidence and adjusted the training, which we really appreciated.

However, there are some areas where improvement is needed, especially since many young children attend these classes.

1. Cold Weather Conditions
Since this is an outdoor pool, strong winds blow directly onto the students during monsoon and winter. It feels cold even for parents sitting outside, and it is difficult for children after they come out of the water. When we raised this concern, we did not receive clear solutions.

2. Temperature-Regulated Pool
The pool is said to be temperature regulated, which is one reason we enrolled. However, during winter we were told that the heater was not working and would be started later. The water remained quite cold, making it difficult for children to complete their sessions comfortably.

3. Communication
Most staff members are polite, but one or two people sometimes speak in a way that feels a bit rude. A more friendly tone would help parents feel more comfortable.

4. Pool Support
There are no support rods or bars along the pool walls for children to hold. These would be helpful for beginners.

5. Washroom Facilities
Many mothers come with young children, but there is only one shower in the female washroom. Because of this, some people have to leave without washing after swimming.

Overall, the teachers are good, but some improvements in facilities and planning would make the experience much better for children and parents.

The pickleball facility at Matoshree Arts & Sports Trust falls significantly short of the standards associated with the Matoshree name. While other amenities within the trust such as the badminton courts, gym, and swimming pool are generally well maintained and professionally managed, the pickleball courts reflect a concerning lack of upkeep and oversight.

The courts are poorly maintained. Basic cleaning appears neglected, with visible dust and debris affecting playability. There is no attendant present to address concerns related to cleanliness or court readiness, which further reflects operational indifference. For a facility operating under an established sports trust, this absence of on ground supervision is disappointing.

The court surface itself is substandard. There are visible damages, craters, and uneven patches across multiple areas. These surface irregularities directly impact gameplay, causing inconsistent and uneven ball bounce. This not only compromises the quality of play but also increases the risk of injury. A sport like pickleball demands a smooth, uniform surface for predictable ball response; the current condition does not meet even basic expectations.

Lighting conditions during morning hours are another issue. Direct sunlight enters the playing area in a way that significantly hampers visibility. Proper shading or structural adjustments appear to be lacking, making early sessions unnecessarily difficult.

The acoustics within the dome shaped structure are also problematic. The roof design amplifies sound excessively, creating an echo heavy environment that becomes distracting during play. Instead of absorbing noise, the structure magnifies it, reducing overall playing comfort.

Overall upkeep of the pickleball section is poor. Given the otherwise strong reputation of Matoshree Arts & Sports Trust for maintaining quality facilities, the condition of the pickleball courts is inconsistent with the standards set by the rest of the complex. Immediate attention from management is required to restore surface quality, ensure routine maintenance, deploy proper supervision, and address structural issues related to light and acoustics. Without corrective action, the facility risks undermining the trust’s broader reputation for sporting excellence.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit G.
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a peaceful club located in the centre of Sher-e-Punjab. Google Maps is not very accurate but you can ask the local shopkeepers for exact directions. The club offers limited facilities to non-members and this review is from a member's point of view.

Restaurant:
The food prices are subsidised. Quantity is good compared to the price. Food quality is also good. Be very careful while placing the drinks order with the restaurant manager (didn't get his name, but he's slightly aged and bald). Be very clear if he takes your order because he will bring a 60ml drink when you ask for 30ml and sometimes he will bring the second drink and pour in your glass before you can stop him. Then you have to pay the bill for the extra drinks also.

Swimming Pool:
Excellent and large swimming pool. They clean the pool every Tuesday, but empty and clean it once a month. There are two levels of diving boards and one lifeguard at all times.

Gym:
The gym was renovated 3-4 years back. Equipment is strictly okay but the biggest benefit of thisbplace is the availability of a jacuzzi and steam room.

Rooms:
There are only 7-8 rooms here and prices are reasonable for the quality. Sometimes you can get old bedsheets which have holes, but if you inform the reception they will change it immediately.

featured_reviews.name: Hemanth Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of Mumbai’s most well-planned and versatile sports complexes. It truly stands out as a one-stop gymkhana offering an impressive range of facilities under one roof.
The complex offers multiple sports options including Swimming, Rifle Shooting, Gymnastics, Table Tennis, Pickleball, Roller Skating and more, making it suitable for children, professionals, fitness enthusiasts and competitive athletes alike.
The infrastructure is modern, clean and well maintained, creating a great environment for training and recreation.
A big highlight is the Sollasa Sports Café, which serves quality food at reasonable prices—perfect for a healthy meal or quick snack after a workout or a game.
The Sports Recovery Centre is another major attraction, featuring Sauna, Steam, Massage and Hydrotherapy facilities, giving athletes and fitness lovers a professional space to recover and rejuvenate.
The Terrace Turf is ideal for a quick game of football and cricket, offering a great playing experience with a city view.
Complex also has at least two well-sized halls that are perfect for engagements, birthday parties, naming ceremonies, society meetings, and small get-togethers.
All in all, Prabodhan Thackeray Krida Sankul is a true one-stop destination for sports, fitness, recreation and social gatherings, offering excellent value for money and a wide variety of facilities rarely found together in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket
featured_reviews.review_text:
Prabodhankar Thackeray Swimming Pool is the only swimming facility of its scale in and around Vile Parle, making it a highly sought-after destination for fitness enthusiasts and learners of all ages. Getting admission to the swimming classes can be a challenge due to the high demand, but those who manage to secure a spot find the experience worthwhile. The pool caters to various age groups and skill levels, offering batches throughout the day.

Beyond swimming, the complex has developed into a multi-sport hub. It features facilities like pickleball courts, carrom tables, a small cricket turf, and even a well-equipped gymnastics hall, attracting young athletes and hobby players alike. There is also a small sports shop inside the premises where basic sports equipment and accessories are available.

One of the highlights many visitors appreciate is the canteen. Known for its omelette and poha, it serves fresh, satisfying snacks and also offers a decent missal that regulars enjoy after their sessions.

The place is fairly well maintained and serves as a much-needed sports center for the residents of Vile Parle. With its growing range of facilities and community-friendly atmosphere, it continues to be an important recreational and fitness landmark in the locality.
